Corrigendum
Date: 19.03.2025
The university vide its notification dated 17.03.2025 had displayed the revised
eligibility/API score of candidates for the post of Assistant Professor (after considering all
the grievances of the candidates).
However, it was brought to notice today i.e. 19.03.2025, that there was an
inadvertent mistake in the API score because of the “conversion of CGPA to percentage
marks” of the candidate named Mr. AKESHWAR SINGH YADAV (Form No. CUT285 /
Roll No. 140285) of Mechanical Engineering mentioned at S. No. 42 of the “displayed list”.
This inadvertent error has now been corrected and accordingly, his score
corrected and revised from 83 to 85 by the screening committee. The revised list of
“candidates along with their API score” is being displayed with this corrigendum.
All other conditions of the notification dated 17.03.2025 remain the same.
Registrar
Harcourt Butler Technical University
